pravallika.text:
[PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY]
Automation Test Engineer with 4+ years of experience specializing in validating industrial control systems, PLC/SCADA platforms, and embedded software before they go live. Proven track record eliminating defects at the FAT/SAT stage across manufacturing, oil & gas, and automotive environments. Proficient in Python, Pytest, JIRA, TestRail, and REST API testing, with hands-on expertise in Allen-Bradley, Siemens, and Ignition automation platforms. Experienced in CI/CD-integrated test pipelines using Jenkins and Azure DevOps for automated regression execution across industrial software deployments.

[TECHNICAL SKILLS]
Core Testing: Functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, system testing, API testing, UAT, smoke testing, sanity testing, black-box testing, white-box testing, exploratory testing.
Test Automation & Tools: Pytest, Robot Framework, Selenium, Python test scripting, Postman, SoapUI, REST API testing, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git.
Test Management: JIRA, TestRail, ServiceNow, test case development, traceability matrices, defect density tracking, test coverage metrics, defect reporting.
Industrial Validation: FAT/SAT execution, I/O validation, loop testing, control system validation, HMI/SCADA testing, safety interlock validation, commissioning documentation.
Manufacturing & SCADA Platforms: Ignition SCADA, FactoryTalk View SE, Siemens WinCC, Wonderware InTouch, Allen-Bradley ControlLogix, Siemens S7-1200/1500, OPC UA, Modbus TCP/IP.
Data & Reporting: SQL-based data validation, OSIsoft PI Historian, historian data verification, OPC UA data validation, operational data verification, test execution reporting.
Embedded & Automotive Testing: C/C++ unit testing, CAN bus communication validation, sensor signal validation, firmware regression testing, ECU boundary condition analysis, hardware-in-the-loop validation.
Standards & Compliance: IEC 61131-3, Agile/Scrum, V-model, TDD, NFPA 70, OSHA compliance, safety interlock validation, quality assurance standards.

[PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE]
Saulsbury Industries | USA | Automation Test Engineer | 09/2024 – Present
- Developed and executed comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts for PLC-based automation and HMI/SCADA systems across industrial plant automation projects in energy and manufacturing environments.
- Performed Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) for large-scale control system deployments, achieving zero critical deficiencies across all project milestones.
- Executed functional and regression testing for Siemens WinCC HMI applications and Allen-Bradley ControlLogix PLC logic, identifying and resolving 14 operator interface defects prior to production go-live.
- Executed integration testing for PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, and OPC UA communication networks, identifying 9 data integrity and device configuration defects across distributed automation environments prior to startup.
- Developed Python-based test automation scripts and reusable IEC 61131-3 compliant test templates, reducing manual test execution effort by 30% across a 4-week FAT/SAT cycle.
- Performed I/O validation, loop testing, and safety interlock verification for FANUC robotics and Cognex D905 vision inspection systems, executing 90+ test cases across 4 production line configurations with zero post-go-live defect escapes.
- Maintained detailed test documentation including test strategies, traceability matrices, defect reports, I/O lists, and control narratives, accelerating project handover across 3 concurrent automation projects.
- Executed smoke testing and sanity testing on newly deployed HMI builds and PLC program updates, reducing post-deployment defect escape rate from 9 to 6 issues per release cycle.
- Coordinated with controls, electrical, and mechanical teams to define test acceptance criteria, track defect resolution, and verify fixes through structured re-test cycles across 3 concurrent automation projects.

Targa Resources | USA | Automation Test Engineer | 04/2023 – 08/2024
- Designed and executed functional, integration, and regression test cases for Ignition SCADA dashboards, alarm management systems, and historian reporting platforms across midstream oil & gas operations.
- Validated operational data accuracy using SQL queries against PI Historian and SCADA databases, identifying 3 critical data discrepancies across distributed facilities resolved before production go-live.
- Performed end-to-end integration testing for EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, and OPC UA communication interfaces, verifying system availability above 98% across 4 distributed facilities.
- Validated REST API data exchange between SCADA historian platforms and enterprise reporting systems using Postman, identifying 4 data mapping defects resolved before production deployment.
- Executed user acceptance testing (UAT) and business process validation for asset monitoring and operational reporting platforms used by operations and maintenance teams.
- Developed test documentation including test strategies, traceability matrices, and defect reports, improving test coverage and reducing post-deployment issues across 3 automation upgrade projects.

MEL Systems | India | Embedded Test Engineer | 12/2019 – 07/2021
- Designed and executed functional validation, regression testing, and boundary condition test cases for safety-critical automotive embedded control software written in C/C++.
- Validated OSIsoft PI Historian data integration with SCADA platforms by executing 40+ data integrity test cases, identifying 3 critical data mapping defects resolved before production go-live.
- Performed CAN bus communication stack validation under nominal and fault-injection conditions across 8 ECU modules, identifying 14 timing violations and verifying resolution through structured regression testing.
- Developed Pytest-based automated test scripts for sensor validation and data acquisition workflows, reducing manual validation effort by 5 hours per week across the embedded software team.
- Validated sensor-to-actuator response timing and boundary conditions for safety-critical control units, achieving first-pass compliance certification with zero rework cycles.
- Executed end-to-end embedded system validation and commissioning testing, delivering final release on schedule with zero critical defects reported in the 90-day post-deployment warranty period.
